name: dexterm
description: Local Solana memecoin research, rug checks, LARP evidence, and holder analysis over MCP.
long_description: dexterm exposes 44 MCP tools for Solana memecoin research: token dossiers, holder analysis, security and rug checks, mechanical LARP evidence with a 0-100 LARP score, the advertised X account, candles, trades, knowledge resources, and bounded app navigation, plus six opt-in paper-trading tools that book simulated trades only inside a mandate the user armed. Market and web reads use public or user-configured sources and report missing data as unavailable. No MCP tool can arm, sign or send a real trade, raise a signer cap, or change the keypress confirmation gate. The source is AGPL-3.0-only.
